title: skyBlip simulator scenario (v1)
description: One scenario drives the browser simulator, the terminal simulator and the host regression suite. Parsed and replayed by firmware/simulator/world.

callsign.description: The name the simulated device transmits, S-BLIP when absent

turn_dps.description: Own-ship turn rate, degrees per second, positive to the right. A thermalling glider holds 13 to 18.

system.description: What reaches us from this aircraft: its own ADS-L or FLARM-generation burst on the M band, or a skyPost ground station's O-band relay of it, which is what 'adsl_uplink' means. An 'adsl_uplink' aircraft never transmits itself. The system is the only thing that decides whether our shared sync window frames this aircraft's bursts.

turn_dps.description: Turn rate of this aircraft, degrees per second, positive to the right.

climb_mps_e1.description: Vertical rate of this aircraft, tenths of a metre per second, positive up. It is broadcast as the aircraft's climb rate and its height moves at it, so a 30 (3 m/s, 590 fpm) thermalling glider wears a climb chevron on the radar tag and its altitude tag counts up.
